translations.literal: The chief attendant arranged facing seats, bowed again to the emperor's daughter; both took their seats, received cups and drank three times, both rose, bowed twice, and the announcer cleared the wine.
translations.idiomatic: The chief attendant arranged facing seats and bowed again to the emperor's daughter. Both took their seats, received cups and drank three times, then both rose and bowed twice as the announcer cleared the wine.

sentences.zh: 見舅姑。

translations.literal: Meeting the father-in-law and mother-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: Meeting the father-in-law and mother-in-law.

sentences.zh: 夙興，帝姬著花釵、服褕翟以俟見。

translations.literal: At dawn she rose early; the emperor's daughter put on flower hairpins and wore the bordered pheasant robe to await the meeting.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn she rose early; the emperor's daughter put on flower hairpins and wore the bordered pheasant robe to await the meeting.

sentences.zh: 讚者設舅姑位於堂上，舅位於東，姑位於西，各服其服就位。

translations.literal: The announcer set seats for the father-in-law and mother-in-law in the hall—the father-in-law's seat in the east, the mother-in-law's in the west—each wearing appropriate dress and taking their positions.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer set seats for the father-in-law and mother-in-law in the hall—the father-in-law's seat in the east, the mother-in-law's in the west—each in appropriate dress and taking their positions.

sentences.zh: 女相者引帝姬升自西階，詣舅位前再拜，讚者以棗栗授 帝姬奉置舅位前，舅即坐，讚者進徹以東，帝姬退，復位，又再拜。

translations.literal: The lady attendant led the emperor's daughter up the western steps; she went before the father-in-law's seat and bowed twice; the announcer handed her dates and chestnuts, which she reverently placed before the father-in-law's seat; the father-in-law took his seat; the announcer advanced and cleared them eastward; the emperor's daughter withdrew, returned to her position, and bowed twice again.
translations.idiomatic: The lady attendant led the emperor's daughter up the western steps to bow twice before the father-in-law's seat. The announcer handed her dates and chestnuts, which she reverently placed before his seat. The father-in-law took his seat; the announcer advanced and cleared them eastward. The emperor's daughter withdrew, returned to her position, and bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 女相者引詣姑位前再拜，讚者以腶修授帝姬奉置姑位前，姑即坐，讚者亦徹以東，帝姬退，復 位，又再拜。

translations.literal: The lady attendant led her before the mother-in-law's seat to bow twice; the announcer handed her preserved meat, which the emperor's daughter reverently placed before the mother-in-law's seat; the mother-in-law took her seat; the announcer also cleared them eastward; the emperor's daughter withdrew, returned to her position, and bowed twice again.
translations.idiomatic: The lady attendant led her before the mother-in-law's seat to bow twice. The announcer handed her preserved meat, which she reverently placed before the mother-in-law's seat. The mother-in-law took her seat; the announcer also cleared them eastward. The emperor's daughter withdrew, returned to her position, and bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 次醴婦、盥饋、饗婦如儀。

translations.literal: Next, presenting wine to the bride, washing and offering food, and feasting the bride followed according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Next came presenting wine to the bride, washing and offering food, and feasting the bride, all according to ritual.

sentences.zh: 諸王納妃。

translations.literal: Princes taking brides.
translations.idiomatic: Princes taking brides.

sentences.zh: 宋朝之製，諸王聘禮，賜女家白金萬兩。

translations.literal: Under Song dynasty regulations, for princes' betrothal gifts, ten thousand taels of white gold were granted to the bride's family.
translations.idiomatic: Under Song regulations, for princes' betrothal gifts, ten thousand taels of white gold were granted to the bride's family.

sentences.zh: 敲門，

translations.literal: Knocking at the door,
translations.idiomatic: Knocking at the door,

sentences.zh: 〈（即古之納采。）〉

translations.literal: (That is, the ancient presenting-the-initial-gift rite.)
translations.idiomatic: (This is the ancient rite of presenting the initial gift.)

sentences.zh: 用羊二十口、酒二十壺、彩四十 匹。

translations.literal: Twenty sheep, twenty jars of wine, and forty bolts of colored silk were used.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty sheep, twenty jars of wine, and forty bolts of colored silk were used.

sentences.zh: 定禮，羊、酒、彩各加十，茗百斤，頭{須巾}巾段、綾、絹三十匹，黃金釵釧四雙，條脫一副，真珠虎珀瓔珞、真珠翠毛玉釵朵各二副，銷金生色衣各一襲， 金塗銀合二，錦繡綾羅三百匹，果槃、花粉、花冪、眠羊臥鹿花餅、銀勝、小色金銀錢等物。

translations.literal: For fixing the betrothal gift: ten each were added to the sheep, wine, and colored silk; a hundred jin of tea; thirty bolts of headcloth sections, damask, and silk; four pairs of gold hairpins and bracelets; one set of armlets; two sets each of pearl, amber, and coral necklaces and pearl, kingfisher-feather, and jade hair ornaments; one set each of gold-trimmed ceremonial robes; two gold-plated silver cases; three hundred bolts of brocade, embroidery, damask, and gauze; and fruit platters, powdered cosmetics, floral veils, reclining-sheep and recumbent-deer flower cakes, silver victory ornaments, small-colored gold and silver coins, and other such items.
translations.idiomatic: For fixing the betrothal gift, ten each were added to the sheep, wine, and colored silk, along with a hundred jin of tea; thirty bolts of headcloth sections, damask, and silk; four pairs of gold hairpins and bracelets; one set of armlets; two sets each of pearl, amber, and coral necklaces and pearl, kingfisher-feather, and jade hair ornaments; one set each of gold-trimmed ceremonial robes; two gold-plated silver cases; three hundred bolts of brocade, embroidery, damask, and gauze; and fruit platters, powdered cosmetics, floral veils, reclining-sheep and recumbent-deer flower cakes, silver victory ornaments, small-colored gold and silver coins, and other such items.

sentences.zh: 納財，用金器百兩、彩千匹、錢五十萬、錦綺、綾、羅、絹各三百匹， 銷金繡畫衣十襲，真珠翠毛玉釵朵各三副，函書一架纏束帛，押馬函馬二十匹，羊五十口，酒五十壺，係羊酒紅絹百匹，花粉、花冪、果盤、銀勝、羅勝等物。

translations.literal: For presenting marriage wealth: a hundred taels of gold vessels, a thousand bolts of colored silk, five hundred thousand coins, three hundred bolts each of brocade, damask, gauze, and silk; ten sets of gold-trimmed embroidered robes; three sets each of pearl, kingfisher-feather, and jade hair ornaments; one case of documents wrapped in silk; twenty horses to accompany the document case; fifty sheep; fifty jars of wine; a hundred bolts of red silk binding the sheep and wine; powdered cosmetics, floral veils, fruit platters, silver victory ornaments, gauze victory ornaments, and other such items.
translations.idiomatic: For presenting marriage wealth, there were a hundred taels of gold vessels, a thousand bolts of colored silk, five hundred thousand coins, and three hundred bolts each of brocade, damask, gauze, and silk; ten sets of gold-trimmed embroidered robes; three sets each of pearl, kingfisher-feather, and jade hair ornaments; one case of documents wrapped in silk; twenty horses to accompany the document case; fifty sheep; fifty jars of wine; a hundred bolts of red silk binding the sheep and wine; powdered cosmetics, floral veils, fruit platters, silver victory ornaments, gauze victory ornaments, and other such items.

sentences.zh: 親 迎，用塗金銀裝肩輿一，行障、坐障各一，方團掌扇四，引障花十樹，生色燭籠十，高髻釵插並童子八人騎分左右導扇輿。

translations.literal: For personally welcoming the bride: one shoulder-borne palanquin with gold and silver ornamentation; one traveling screen and one seated screen; four square and round hand fans; ten trees of guiding-screen flowers; ten colored candle lanterns; eight pages with high topknots, hairpins, and plumes riding on either side to guide the fan palanquin.
translations.idiomatic: For personally welcoming the bride, there was one shoulder-borne palanquin with gold and silver ornamentation; one traveling screen and one seated screen; four square and round hand fans; ten trees of guiding-screen flowers; ten colored candle lanterns; and eight pages with high topknots, hairpins, and plumes riding on either side to guide the fan palanquin.

sentences.zh: 其宗室子聘禮，賜女家白金五千兩。

translations.literal: For imperial clansmen's betrothal gifts, five thousand taels of white gold were granted to the bride's family.
translations.idiomatic: For imperial clansmen's betrothal gifts, five thousand taels of white gold were granted to the bride's family.

sentences.zh: 其敲 門、定禮、納財、親迎禮皆減半，遠屬族卑者又減之。

translations.literal: The rites of knocking at the door, fixing the betrothal gift, presenting marriage wealth, and personally welcoming the bride were all reduced by half; for distant collateral kin of lower rank they were reduced further.
translations.idiomatic: The rites of knocking at the door, fixing the betrothal gift, presenting marriage wealth, and personally welcoming the bride were all reduced by half; for distant collateral kin of lower rank they were reduced further still.

sentences.zh: 政和三年四月，議禮局上皇子納夫人儀：

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year of Zhenghe, the Bureau for Discussing Ritual submitted the ceremony for a prince taking a principal wife:
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year of Zhenghe, the Bureau for Discussing Ritual submitted the ceremony for a prince taking a principal wife:

sentences.zh: 采擇。

translations.literal: Selecting and choosing.
translations.idiomatic: Selecting and choosing.

sentences.zh: 使者曰：“奉制，某王之儷，屬子懿淑。

translations.literal: The envoy said: "By imperial command, the consort of Prince So-and-so belongs to a family of fine virtue and gentle conduct.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy said: "By imperial command, the consort of Prince So-and-so belongs to a family of fine virtue and gentle conduct.

sentences.zh: 謹之重之，使某行采擇之禮。

translations.literal: I treat this with reverence and weight, and am sent to perform the rite of selection and choice.
translations.idiomatic: I treat this with the utmost reverence, and am sent to perform the rite of selection and choice.

sentences.zh: ”儐者入告，主人曰：“臣某之子顓愚，不足以備采擇，恭承製命，臣某不敢辭。”

translations.literal: " The usher entered to report; the host said: "My son So-and-so is dull and foolish, unworthy to be chosen; reverently accepting the imperial command, your subject So-and-so dares not decline.
translations.idiomatic: " The usher entered to report; the host said: "My son So-and-so is dull and foolish, unworthy to be chosen. Reverently accepting the imperial command, your subject So-and-so dares not decline.

sentences.zh: 問名。

translations.literal: Asking the name.
translations.idiomatic: Asking the name.

sentences.zh: 使者曰：“某王之儷，采擇既諧。

translations.literal: The envoy said: "The consort of Prince So-and-so—selection and choice are already in accord.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy said: "The consort of Prince So-and-so—selection and choice are already in accord.

sentences.zh: 將加官占，奉制問名。

translations.literal: Official divination will now be added; by imperial command I ask the name.
translations.idiomatic: Official divination will now be performed; by imperial command I ask the name.

sentences.zh: ”儐者入告，主人曰：“製以臣某之子，可以奉侍某王，臣某不敢辭。”

translations.literal: " The usher entered to report; the host said: "By imperial command my son So-and-so may serve Prince So-and-so; your subject So-and-so dares not decline.
translations.idiomatic: " The usher entered to report; the host said: "By imperial command my son So-and-so may serve Prince So-and-so; your subject So-and-so dares not decline.

sentences.zh: 告吉。

translations.literal: Announcing the auspicious sign.
translations.idiomatic: Announcing the auspicious sign.

sentences.zh: 使者曰：“官占既吉，奉制以告。

translations.literal: The envoy said: "Official divination is already auspicious; by imperial command I announce it.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy said: "Official divination is already auspicious; by imperial command I announce it.

sentences.zh: ”儐者入告，主人曰：“臣某之子，愚弗克堪。

translations.literal: " The usher entered to report; the host said: "My son So-and-so is foolish and cannot bear the burden.
translations.idiomatic: " The usher entered to report; the host said: "My son So-and-so is foolish and cannot bear the burden.

sentences.zh: 占貺之吉，臣與有幸。

translations.literal: That divination has granted an auspicious sign—your subject shares in good fortune.
translations.idiomatic: That divination has granted an auspicious sign—your subject shares in good fortune.

sentences.zh: 臣某謹奉典制。”

translations.literal: Your subject So-and-so reverently accepts the canonical regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject So-and-so reverently accepts the canonical regulations.

sentences.zh: 告成。

translations.literal: Announcing completion.
translations.idiomatic: Announcing completion.

sentences.zh: 使者曰：“官占雲吉，嘉偶既定，製使某以儀物告成。

translations.literal: The envoy said: "Official divination declares auspicious; the fine match is now settled; by imperial command I am sent to announce completion with ritual objects.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy said: "Official divination declares the match auspicious; the fine union is now settled; by imperial command I am sent to announce completion with ritual objects.

sentences.zh: ”儐者入告，主人曰：“奉制賜臣以重禮，臣某謹奉典制。”

translations.literal: " The usher entered to report; the host said: "By imperial command I am granted heavy gifts; your subject So-and-so reverently accepts the canonical regulations.
translations.idiomatic: " The usher entered to report; the host said: "By imperial command I am granted heavy gifts; your subject So-and-so reverently accepts the canonical regulations.

sentences.zh: 告期。

translations.literal: Announcing the date.
translations.idiomatic: Announcing the date.

sentences.zh: 使者曰：“涓辰之良，某月某日吉，製使某告期。

translations.literal: The envoy said: "The chosen day is fine—such-and-such month, such-and-such day is auspicious; by imperial command I am sent to announce the date.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy said: "The chosen day is fine—such-and-such month, such-and-such day is auspicious; by imperial command I am sent to announce the date.

sentences.zh: ”儐者入告，主人曰：“臣某謹奉典制。

translations.literal: " The usher entered to report; the host said: "Your subject So-and-so reverently accepts the canonical regulations.
translations.idiomatic: " The usher entered to report; the host said: "Your subject So-and-so reverently accepts the canonical regulations.

sentences.zh: ”前期，太史局擇日，奏告景靈宮。

translations.literal: " In advance, the Astrological Bureau chose the day and memorialized to announce it at the Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: " In advance, the Astrological Bureau chose the day and memorialized to announce it at the Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 賜告。

translations.literal: Bestowing the announcement.
translations.idiomatic: Bestowing the announcement.

sentences.zh: 前一日，主人設使者次，如常儀，

translations.literal: On the day before, the host set up the envoy's pavilion according to the usual ritual,
translations.idiomatic: On the day before, the host set up the envoy's pavilion according to the usual ritual,

sentences.zh: 〈（使者以內侍為之。）〉

translations.literal: (The envoy was an inner attendant.)
translations.idiomatic: (The envoy was an inner attendant.)

sentences.zh: 又設告箱之次於中門外，北向，隨闕所向，設香案於寢庭。

translations.literal: and also set up the announcement-case pavilion outside the middle gate facing north, according to the direction of the palace gap; an incense table was set in the inner courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: And also set up the announcement-case pavilion outside the middle gate facing north, according to the direction of the palace gap. An incense table was set in the inner courtyard.

sentences.zh: 其日大昕，使者公服至，主人出迎於大 門外，北向再拜，使者不答拜。

translations.literal: At dawn that day, the envoy arrived in official dress; the host went out to welcome him outside the great gate, bowed twice facing north, and the envoy did not return the bow.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn that day, the envoy arrived in official dress. The host went out to welcome him outside the great gate, bowed twice facing north, and the envoy did not return the bow.

sentences.zh: 謁者引使者入門而左，主人入門而右，舉告箱者同入。

translations.literal: The usher led the envoy in through the gate to the left; the host entered through the gate to the right; the bearer of the announcement case entered together with them.
translations.idiomatic: The usher led the envoy in through the gate to the left; the host entered through the gate to the right; and the bearer of the announcement case entered together with them.

sentences.zh: 主人立香案左，使者在右，舉告箱者以告置於香案。

translations.literal: The host stood to the left of the incense table, the envoy to the right; the bearer of the announcement case placed the announcement on the incense table.
translations.idiomatic: The host stood to the left of the incense table, the envoy to the right. The bearer of the announcement case placed the announcement on the incense table.

sentences.zh: 女相者引夫人出，麵闕 立，使者稱有制，女相者讚再拜，使者曰：“賜某國夫人告。

translations.literal: The lady attendant led the lady out; she faced the palace gap and stood; the envoy declared that there was an imperial command; the lady attendant prompted her to bow twice; the envoy said: "I bestow the announcement of Lady of Such-and-such State.
translations.idiomatic: The lady attendant led the lady out; she faced the palace gap and stood. The envoy declared that there was an imperial command; the lady attendant prompted her to bow twice. The envoy said: "I bestow the announcement of Lady of Such-and-such State.

sentences.zh: ”又讚再拜，退，使者出。

translations.literal: " She was prompted to bow twice again, withdrew, and the envoy departed.
translations.idiomatic: " She was prompted to bow twice again, withdrew, and the envoy departed.

sentences.zh: 皇帝醮戒於所禦之殿，皇子乘象輅親迎。

translations.literal: The emperor performed the ablution and fast in the hall where he resided; the prince rode the elephant carriage to personally welcome the bride.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor performed the ablution and fast in the hall where he resided; the prince rode the elephant carriage to personally welcome the bride.

sentences.zh: 同牢、夫人朝見、盥饋、皇帝皇后饗夫人如儀。

translations.literal: Sharing the sacrificial feast, the lady's audience, washing and offering food, and the emperor and empress feasting the lady followed according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Sharing the sacrificial feast, the lady's audience, washing and offering food, and the emperor and empress feasting the lady all followed according to ritual.

sentences.zh: 其諸王以下：

translations.literal: For princes and those below:
translations.idiomatic: For princes and those below:

sentences.zh: 納采。

translations.literal: Presenting the initial gift.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting the initial gift.

sentences.zh: 賓曰：“某官以伉儷之重，施於某王，

translations.literal: The guest said: "Official So-and-so, considering the weight of marriage, applies it to Prince So-and-so,
translations.idiomatic: The guest said: "Official So-and-so, considering the weight of marriage, applies it to Prince So-and-so,

sentences.zh: 〈（某官謂主人，某王謂婿。）〉

translations.literal: (Official So-and-so refers to the host; Prince So-and-so refers to the groom.)
translations.idiomatic: (Official So-and-so refers to the host; Prince So-and-so refers to the groom.)

sentences.zh: 某王率循彝典，以某將事，敢請納采。”

translations.literal: Prince So-and-so follows the canonical rites, and with So-and-so as envoy I venture to request presenting the initial gift.
translations.idiomatic: Prince So-and-so follows the canonical rites, and with So-and-so as envoy I venture to request presenting the initial gift.

sentences.zh: 〈（某王謂婿父，某謂賓。）〉

translations.literal: (Prince So-and-so refers to the groom's father; So-and-so refers to the guest.)
translations.idiomatic: (Prince So-and-so refers to the groom's father; So-and-so refers to the guest.)

sentences.zh: 儐者入告，主人曰：“某之子弗閑於姆訓，維是腶修、棗栗之饋，未知所以告虔也。

translations.literal: The usher entered to report; the host said: "My son So-and-so is not versed in the matron's instruction; only this offering of preserved meat, dates, and chestnuts—I do not know how to declare my reverence.
translations.idiomatic: The usher entered to report; the host said: "My son So-and-so is not versed in the matron's instruction; only this offering of preserved meat, dates, and chestnuts—I do not know how to declare my reverence.

sentences.zh: 某聽命於廟，敢不拜嘉。”

translations.literal: So-and-so receives the charge at the ancestral temple; how could I fail to bow in acceptance of this favor?
translations.idiomatic: So-and-so receives the charge at the ancestral temple; how could I fail to bow in acceptance of this favor?

sentences.zh: 問名。

translations.literal: Asking the name.
translations.idiomatic: Asking the name.

sentences.zh: 賓曰：“合二姓之好，必稽諸龜筮，敢請問名。

translations.literal: The guest said: "To unite the good of two surnames, one must consult the tortoise and yarrow; I venture to ask the name.
translations.idiomatic: The guest said: "To unite the good of two surnames, one must consult the tortoise and yarrow; I venture to ask the name.

sentences.zh: ”儐者入告，主人曰：“某王恭謹，重正昏禮，將以加諸卜，某敢不以告。”

translations.literal: " The usher entered to report; the host said: "Prince So-and-so is reverent and careful, attaching weight to the proper marriage rite; it will be submitted to divination—So-and-so dares not fail to report it.
translations.idiomatic: " The usher entered to report; the host said: "Prince So-and-so is reverent and careful, attaching weight to the proper marriage rite; it will be submitted to divination—So-and-so dares not fail to report it.

sentences.zh: 納吉。

translations.literal: Presenting the auspicious sign.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting the auspicious sign.

sentences.zh: 賓曰：“某王承嘉命，稽諸卜筮，龜筮協從，使某以告。

translations.literal: The guest said: "Prince So-and-so has received a fine command; consulting divination by tortoise and yarrow, tortoise and yarrow agree in accord; So-and-so is sent to announce it.
translations.idiomatic: The guest said: "Prince So-and-so has received a fine command; consulting divination by tortoise and yarrow, both agree in accord; So-and-so is sent to announce it.

sentences.zh: ”儐者入告，主人曰：“某王不忘寒素，欲施德於某未教之女，而卜以吉告，其曷敢辭。”

translations.literal: " The usher entered to report; the host said: "Prince So-and-so does not forget humble origins and wishes to extend virtue to my untaught daughter; divination has returned an auspicious report—how could I dare decline?
translations.idiomatic: " The usher entered to report; the host said: "Prince So-and-so does not forget humble origins and wishes to extend virtue to my untaught daughter; divination has returned an auspicious report—how could I dare decline?

sentences.zh: 納成。

translations.literal: Presenting completion.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting completion.

sentences.zh: 賓曰：“某官以伉儷之重，施於某王，某王，

translations.literal: The guest said: "Official So-and-so, considering the weight of marriage, applies it to Prince So-and-so, Prince So-and-so,
translations.idiomatic: The guest said: "Official So-and-so, considering the weight of marriage, applies it to Prince So-and-so, Prince So-and-so,

sentences.zh: 〈（上謂婿，下謂婿父。）〉

translations.literal: (The first refers to the groom; the second refers to the groom's father.)
translations.idiomatic: (The first refers to the groom; the second refers to the groom's father.)

sentences.zh: 率循彝典，有不腆之幣，以某將事，敢請納成。

translations.literal: follows the canonical rites; with unworthy gifts, with So-and-so as envoy I venture to request presenting completion.
translations.idiomatic: Follows the canonical rites; with unworthy gifts, with So-and-so as envoy I venture to request presenting completion.

sentences.zh: ”儐者入告，主人曰：“某王順彝典，申之以備物，某敢不重拜嘉。”

translations.literal: " The usher entered to report; the host said: "Prince So-and-so follows the canonical rites and supplements them with complete goods; So-and-so dares not fail to bow deeply in acceptance of this favor.
translations.idiomatic: " The usher entered to report; the host said: "Prince So-and-so follows the canonical rites and supplements them with complete goods; So-and-so dares not fail to bow deeply in acceptance of this favor.

sentences.zh: 請期。

translations.literal: Requesting the date.
translations.idiomatic: Requesting the date.

sentences.zh: 賓曰：“某王謹重嘉禮，將卜諸近日，使某請期。

translations.literal: The guest said: "Prince So-and-so reverently esteems the auspicious rite and will seek divination for a date in the near future; So-and-so is sent to request the date.
translations.idiomatic: The guest said: "Prince So-and-so reverently esteems the auspicious rite and will seek divination for a date in the near future; So-and-so is sent to request the date.

sentences.zh: ”儐者入告，主人再辭。

translations.literal: " The usher entered to report; the host declined again.
translations.idiomatic: " The usher entered to report; the host declined again.

sentences.zh: 儐者出告，賓曰：“某既不獲受命於某官，某王得吉卜曰某日，敢不以告。

translations.literal: The usher went out to report; the guest said: "Since So-and-so did not receive authorization from Official So-and-so, Prince So-and-so obtained an auspicious divination naming such-and-such a day—I dare not fail to announce it.
translations.idiomatic: The usher went out to report; the guest said: "Since So-and-so did not receive authorization from Official So-and-so, Prince So-and-so obtained an auspicious divination naming such-and-such a day—I dare not fail to announce it.

sentences.zh: ”儐者入告，主人曰：“謹奉命以從。”

translations.literal: " The usher entered to report; the host said: "I respectfully accept the command and will comply.
translations.idiomatic: " The usher entered to report; the host said: "I respectfully accept the command and will comply.

sentences.zh: 親迎。

translations.literal: Fetching the bride in person.
translations.idiomatic: Fetching the bride in person.

sentences.zh: 前一日，主人設賓次，

translations.literal: On the day before, the host set up the guest pavilion,
translations.idiomatic: On the day before, the host set up the guest pavilion,

translations.literal: (The guest refers to the groom.)
translations.idiomatic: (The guest refers to the groom.)

sentences.zh: 如常儀。

translations.literal: following the usual procedure.
translations.idiomatic: Following the usual procedure.

sentences.zh: 其日大昕，婿之父服其服，告於禰廟，

translations.literal: On that day at broad dawn, the groom's father dressed in his proper attire and announced at the temple of the immediate forebear,
translations.idiomatic: On that day at broad dawn, the groom's father dressed in his proper attire and announced at the temple of the immediate forebear,

sentences.zh: 〈（無廟者設神位於廳東，不應設位者不設。）〉

translations.literal: (Where there is no ancestral temple, a spirit seat is set in the east of the hall; where a seat should not be set, none is set.)
translations.idiomatic: (Where there is no ancestral temple, a spirit seat is set in the east of the hall; where a seat should not be set, none is set.)

sentences.zh: 子將行，父醮之於廳事。

translations.literal: When the son was about to depart, the father performed the parting libation for him in the reception hall.
translations.idiomatic: When the son was about to depart, the father performed the parting libation for him in the reception hall.

sentences.zh: 讚者設父位中間，南向，設子位父位之西，近南，東向。

translations.literal: The announcer set the father's seat in the center, facing south; the son's seat was set west of the father's seat, near the south, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer set the father's seat in the center, facing south; the son's seat was set west of the father's seat, near the south, facing east.

sentences.zh: 父即坐，子公服升自西階，進立位前。

translations.literal: The father took his seat; the son in official dress ascended by the western steps and advanced to stand before his seat.
translations.idiomatic: The father took his seat; the son in official dress ascended by the western steps and advanced to stand before his seat.

sentences.zh: 讚者注酒於盞，西向授子，子再拜，跪受，讚者又設饌父位前，子舉 酒興，即坐飲食訖，降，再拜，進立於父位前。

translations.literal: The announcer poured wine into a cup and, facing west, handed it to the son; the son bowed twice, knelt to receive it; the announcer also set food before the father's seat; the son raised his cup in pledge, then sat, ate and drank to completion, descended, bowed twice, and advanced to stand before the father's seat.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer poured wine into a cup and, facing west, handed it to the son; the son bowed twice, knelt to receive it; the announcer also set food before the father's seat; the son raised his cup in pledge, then sat, ate and drank to completion, descended, bowed twice, and advanced to stand before the father's seat.

sentences.zh: 命之曰：“躬迎嘉偶，厘爾內治。

translations.literal: He charged him, saying: "Go in person to fetch your fine match and put your inner household in order.
translations.idiomatic: He charged him, saying: "Go in person to fetch your fine match and put your inner household in order.

sentences.zh: ”子再拜，曰：“敢不奉命。

translations.literal: " The son bowed twice and said: "How could I dare not accept the command?
translations.idiomatic: " The son bowed twice and said: "How could I dare not accept the command?

sentences.zh: ”又再拜，降出，詣女家。

translations.literal: " He bowed twice again, descended and departed, and went to the bride's home.
translations.idiomatic: " He bowed twice again, descended and departed, and went to the bride's home.

sentences.zh: 主人服其服，告於禰廟， 如請期之儀。

translations.literal: The host dressed in his proper attire and announced at the temple of the immediate forebear, following the procedure for requesting the date.
translations.idiomatic: The host dressed in his proper attire and announced at the temple of the immediate forebear, following the procedure for requesting the date.

sentences.zh: 賓將至，主人設神位於寢戶外之西，設醴女位於戶內，南向，具酒饌。

translations.literal: When the guest was about to arrive, the host set a spirit seat west of the outer door of the bedchamber, set the bride's ceremonial seat for sweet wine inside the door facing south, and prepared wine and food.
translations.idiomatic: When the guest was about to arrive, the host set a spirit seat west of the outer door of the bedchamber, set the bride's ceremonial seat for sweet wine inside the door facing south, and prepared wine and food.

sentences.zh: 賓至，讚者引就次，女盛服於房中，就位南向立，姆位於右，從者陪其後。

translations.literal: When the guest arrived, the announcer led him to the pavilion; the bride in full dress was in the inner room, took her place standing facing south; the instructress stood to her right, and attendants followed behind.
translations.idiomatic: When the guest arrived, the announcer led him to the pavilion; the bride in full dress was in the inner room, took her place standing facing south; the instructress stood to her right, and attendants followed behind.

sentences.zh: 父公 服升自東階，立於寢戶外之東，西向。

translations.literal: The father in formal dress ascended by the eastern steps and stood east of the outer door of the bedchamber, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The father in formal dress ascended by the eastern steps and stood east of the outer door of the bedchamber, facing west.

sentences.zh: 內讚者設酒饌，女就位坐，飲食訖，降，再拜，內讚者徹酒饌。

translations.literal: The inner announcer set out wine and food; the bride took her seat, ate and drank to completion, descended, and bowed twice; the inner announcer removed the wine and food.
translations.idiomatic: The inner announcer set out wine and food; the bride took her seat, ate and drank to completion, descended, and bowed twice; the inner announcer removed the wine and food.

sentences.zh: 主人降立東階東南，西面，讚者引賓出次，立於門西，東面， 儐者進受命，出請事，賓曰：“某受命於父，以茲嘉禮，躬聽成命。

translations.literal: The host descended and stood southeast of the eastern steps, facing west; the announcer led the guest out of the pavilion to stand west of the gate, facing east; the usher advanced to receive instructions, went out to ask about the matter, and the guest said: "So-and-so has received a command from his father and, by this auspicious rite, comes in person to await the completion of the charge.
translations.idiomatic: The host descended and stood southeast of the eastern steps, facing west; the announcer led the guest out of the pavilion to stand west of the gate, facing east; the usher advanced to receive instructions, went out to ask about the matter, and the guest said: "So-and-so has received a command from his father and, by this auspicious rite, comes in person to await the completion of the charge.

sentences.zh: ”儐者入告，主人曰：“某固願從命。

translations.literal: " The usher entered to report; the host said: "So-and-so has long wished to comply with the command.
translations.idiomatic: " The usher entered to report; the host said: "So-and-so has long wished to comply with the command.

sentences.zh: ”儐者出告訖，入引主人迎賓大門外之東，西面揖賓，賓 報揖。

translations.literal: " When the usher had finished reporting and went out, he led the host to receive the guest east of the outer gate; facing west, the host bowed with joined hands to the guest, and the guest returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: " When the usher had finished reporting and went out, he led the host to receive the guest east of the outer gate; facing west, the host bowed with joined hands to the guest, and the guest returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 主人入門而右，賓入門而左，執雁者從入，陳雁於庭，三分庭，一在南，北向。

translations.literal: The host entered the gate and turned right; the guest entered and turned left; the bearer of the wild geese followed in; the geese were displayed in the courtyard, the courtyard divided in three, one portion in the south, facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The host entered the gate and turned right; the guest entered and turned left; the bearer of the wild geese followed in; the geese were displayed in the courtyard, the courtyard divided in three, one portion in the south, facing north.

sentences.zh: 主人升立於東階上，西面；

translations.literal: The host ascended and stood on the eastern steps, facing west;
translations.idiomatic: The host ascended and stood on the eastern steps, facing west;

sentences.zh: 賓升西階進，當寢戶前，北面再拜，降出，主人不 降送。

translations.literal: the guest ascended the western steps, advanced to stand before the bedchamber door, bowed twice facing north, descended and departed; the host did not descend to see him off.
translations.idiomatic: the guest ascended the western steps, advanced to stand before the bedchamber door, bowed twice facing north, descended and departed; the host did not descend to see him off.

sentences.zh: 賓初入門，母出，立於寢戶外之西，南面，賓拜訖，姆引女出於母左，父命之曰：“往之汝家，以順為正，無忘肅恭！

translations.literal: When the guest first entered the gate, the mother came out and stood west of the outer door of the bedchamber, facing south; when the guest's bow was finished, the instructress led the bride out to the mother's left; the father charged her, saying: "Go to your husband's home, take compliance as your standard, and do not forget reverent respect!
translations.idiomatic: When the guest first entered the gate, the mother came out and stood west of the outer door of the bedchamber, facing south; when the guest's bow was finished, the instructress led the bride out to the mother's left; the father charged her, saying: "Go to your husband's home, take compliance as your standard, and do not forget reverent respect!

sentences.zh: ”母戒之曰：“必恭必戒，無違舅姑之 命！

translations.literal: " The mother admonished her, saying: "Be ever reverent and ever careful, and do not disobey the commands of your parents-in-law!
translations.idiomatic: " The mother admonished her, saying: "Be ever reverent and ever careful, and do not disobey the commands of your parents-in-law!

sentences.zh: ”庶母申之曰：“爾誠聽於訓言，無作父母羞！

translations.literal: " The concubine mother reiterated: "Truly heed the words of instruction and do not bring shame upon your parents!
translations.idiomatic: " The concubine mother reiterated: "Truly heed the words of instruction and do not bring shame upon your parents!

sentences.zh: ”女出門，婿先還第。

translations.literal: " The bride went out the gate; the groom returned to his residence first.
translations.idiomatic: " The bride went out the gate; the groom returned to his residence first.

sentences.zh: 其同牢、廟見、見舅姑諸禮，皆如儀。

translations.literal: The rites of sharing the wedding feast, temple presentation, and meeting the parents-in-law all followed the prescribed procedure.
translations.idiomatic: The rites of sharing the wedding feast, temple presentation, and meeting the parents-in-law all followed the prescribed procedure.

sentences.zh: 凡宗室婚姻，治平中， 宗正司言：“宗室女舅姑、夫族未立儀製，皆當創法。

translations.literal: As for imperial clansmen's marriages, in the Zhiping era the Chief of the Imperial Clan Bureau said: "For imperial clanswomen's parents-in-law and the husband's kin, no ritual regulations have yet been established; new rules should all be created.
translations.idiomatic: As for imperial clansmen's marriages, in the Zhiping era the Chief of the Imperial Clan Bureau said: "For imperial clanswomen's parents-in-law and the husband's kin, no ritual regulations have yet been established; new rules should all be created.

sentences.zh: ”詔：“婿家有二世食祿，即許娶宗室女，未仕者與判、司、簿、尉，已任者隨資序推恩。

translations.literal: " An edict stated: "If the groom's family has received stipends for two generations, they may marry an imperial clanswoman; those not yet in office are matched with assistant prefects, section chiefs, clerks, and county captains; those already in office receive favor according to their rank in seniority.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict stated: "If the groom's family has received stipends for two generations, they may marry an imperial clanswoman; those not yet in office are matched with assistant prefects, section chiefs, clerks, and county captains; those already in office receive favor according to their rank in seniority.

sentences.zh: 即婿別祖、女別 房，舊為婚姻而於今卑尊不順者，皆許。

translations.literal: Even where the groom belongs to a different line of descent and the woman to a different branch, former marriage ties that today violate proper order of senior and junior are all permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Even where the groom belongs to a different line of descent and the woman to a different branch, former marriage ties that today violate proper order of senior and junior are all permitted.

sentences.zh: 婿之三代、鄉貫、生月、人材書劄，止令婚主問驗，以告宗正寺、大宗正司，寺、司詳視，如條保明。

translations.literal: Written records of the groom's three generations, native place, birth month, and personal qualities are to be examined only by the marriage sponsor and reported to the Imperial Clan Court and the Chief Imperial Clan Bureau; the court and bureau review them in detail and certify according to the regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Written records of the groom's three generations, native place, birth month, and personal qualities are to be examined only by the marriage sponsor and reported to the Imperial Clan Court and the Chief Imperial Clan Bureau; the court and bureau review them in detail and certify according to the regulations.

sentences.zh: 所進財皆賜婿家，令 止於本宮納財，媒妁、使令之人，非理求匄，許告。

translations.literal: All wealth presented is granted to the groom's family; orders were issued that wealth be accepted only at the bride's palace residence; matchmakers and attendants who made unreasonable demands were permitted to report it.
translations.idiomatic: All wealth presented is granted to the groom's family; orders were issued that wealth be accepted only at the bride's palace residence; matchmakers and attendants who made unreasonable demands were permitted to report it.

sentences.zh: 宗室女事舅姑及見夫之族親，皆如臣庶之家。

translations.literal: Imperial clanswomen's service to parents-in-law and meeting the husband's kinsmen all follow commoners' households.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial clanswomen's service to parents-in-law and meeting the husband's kinsmen all follow commoners' households.

sentences.zh: ”其後又令宗室女再嫁者，祖、父有二代任殿直若州縣官已上，即 許為婚姻。

translations.literal: " Later it was further ordered that for imperial clanswomen remarrying, if grandfather and father had held office for two generations as palace guardsmen or as county and prefectural officials or higher, marriage was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: " Later it was further ordered that for imperial clanswomen remarrying, if grandfather and father had held office for two generations as palace guardsmen or as county and prefectural officials or higher, marriage was permitted.

sentences.zh: 熙寧十年，又詔：“應袒免以上親不得與雜類之家婚嫁，謂舅嚐為仆、姑嚐為娼者。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of the Xining reign, another edict stated: "Relatives within the degree of mourning with bared shoulder and loose cap must not marry into or with miscellaneous households—meaning cases where an uncle on the mother's side was once a servant or an aunt on the father's side was once a courtesan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of the Xining reign, another edict stated: "Relatives within the degree of mourning with bared shoulder and loose cap must not marry into or with miscellaneous households—meaning cases where an uncle on the mother's side was once a servant or an aunt on the father's side was once a courtesan.

sentences.zh: 若父母係化外及見居沿邊兩屬之人，其子孫亦不許為 婚。

translations.literal: If parents were connected to foreign lands or to people currently dwelling on both sides of the borderlands, their descendants were also not permitted to marry.
translations.idiomatic: If parents were connected to foreign lands or to people currently dwelling on both sides of the borderlands, their descendants were also not permitted to marry.

sentences.zh: 緦麻以上親不得與諸司胥吏出職、納粟得官及進納伎術、工商、雜類、惡逆之家子孫通婚。

translations.literal: Relatives within the fifth-degree mourning may not intermarry with descendants of clerks who had left office from various bureaus, those who gained office by presenting grain, those who gained entry by presenting technical skills, or households of artisans, merchants, miscellaneous classes, and grave misconduct.
translations.idiomatic: Relatives within the fifth-degree mourning may not intermarry with descendants of clerks who had left office from various bureaus, those who gained office by presenting grain, those who gained entry by presenting technical skills, or households of artisans, merchants, miscellaneous classes, and grave misconduct.

sentences.zh: 〈（後又禁刑徒人子孫為婚。）〉

translations.literal: (Later, marriage with descendants of convict laborers was also forbidden.)
translations.idiomatic: (Later, marriage with descendants of convict laborers was also forbidden.)

sentences.zh: 應婚嫁者委主婚宗室，擇三代有任州縣 官或殿直以上者，列姓名、家世、州裏、歲數奏上，宗正司驗實召保，付內侍省宣係，聽期而行。

translations.literal: Those eligible to marry were entrusted to the presiding clansman; he selected someone from three generations who had held county or prefectural office or been a palace guardsman or higher, listed name, family background, native district, and age, and submitted a memorial; the Imperial Clan Bureau verified the facts and summoned guarantors, handed the matter to the Inner Service Directorate for notification, and allowed the marriage to proceed on the appointed date.
translations.idiomatic: Those eligible to marry were entrusted to the presiding clansman; he selected someone from three generations who had held county or prefectural office or been a palace guardsman or higher, listed name, family background, native district, and age, and submitted a memorial; the Imperial Clan Bureau verified the facts and summoned guarantors, handed the matter to the Inner Service Directorate for notification, and allowed the marriage to proceed on the appointed date.

sentences.zh: 嫁女則令其婿召保。

translations.literal: When marrying off a daughter, the groom was ordered to summon guarantors.
translations.idiomatic: When marrying off a daughter, the groom was ordered to summon guarantors.

sentences.zh: 其冒妄成婚者，以違製論。

translations.literal: Those who rashly completed marriage in violation were prosecuted for breach of regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Those who rashly completed marriage in violation were prosecuted for breach of regulations.

sentences.zh: 主婚宗室與媒保同 坐，不以赦降，自首者減罪，告者有賞。

translations.literal: The presiding clansman and matchmakers and guarantors shared punishment; amnesties did not apply; self-confession reduced the penalty; informants received reward.
translations.idiomatic: The presiding clansman and matchmakers and guarantors shared punishment; amnesties did not apply; self-confession reduced the penalty; informants received reward.

sentences.zh: 非袒免親者依庶姓法。

translations.literal: Those outside the bared-shoulder-and-cap degree of mourning followed commoners' law.
translations.idiomatic: Those outside the bared-shoulder-and-cap degree of mourning followed commoners' law.

sentences.zh: 宗室離婚，委宗正司審察，若於律有可出之實或不相安，方聽。

translations.literal: Imperial clansmen's divorce was entrusted to the Imperial Clan Bureau for investigation; only if there were lawful grounds for repudiation under statute or the couple could not live in harmony was it permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial clansmen's divorce was entrusted to the Imperial Clan Bureau for investigation; only if there were lawful grounds for repudiation under statute or the couple could not live in harmony was it permitted.

sentences.zh: 若無故捃拾者，劾奏。

translations.literal: If someone groundlessly gathered accusations, impeachment was filed.
translations.idiomatic: If someone groundlessly gathered accusations, impeachment was filed.

sentences.zh: 如許聽離，追 完賜予物，給還嫁資。

translations.literal: If divorce was permitted, granted gifts were fully recovered and dowry returned.
translations.idiomatic: If divorce was permitted, granted gifts were fully recovered and dowry returned.

sentences.zh: 再娶者不給賜。

translations.literal: Remarriage did not receive grants.
translations.idiomatic: Remarriage did not receive grants.

sentences.zh: 非袒免以上親與夫聽離，再嫁者委宗正司審核。

translations.literal: Those outside the bared-shoulder-and-cap degree who divorced from their husbands and remarried were reviewed by the Imperial Clan Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Those outside the bared-shoulder-and-cap degree who divorced from their husbands and remarried were reviewed by the Imperial Clan Bureau.

sentences.zh: 其恩澤已追奪而乞與後夫者，降一等。

translations.literal: If favor already revoked was requested for a later husband, it was reduced one grade.
translations.idiomatic: If favor already revoked was requested for a later husband, it was reduced one grade.

sentences.zh: ”尋詔：“宗女毋得與嚐娶人結婚，再 適者不用此法。”

translations.literal: " Soon an edict stated: "Imperial clanswomen must not marry men who have once taken a wife; remarried women are not subject to this law.
translations.idiomatic: " Soon an edict stated: "Imperial clanswomen must not marry men who have once taken a wife; remarried women are not subject to this law.

sentences.zh: 品官婚禮。

translations.literal: Wedding rites for ranked officials.
translations.idiomatic: Wedding rites for ranked officials.

sentences.zh: 納采、問名、納吉、納成、請期、親迎、同牢、廟見、見舅姑、姑醴婦、盥饋、饗婦、送者，並如諸王以下婚。

translations.literal: Initial gift presentation, asking the name, presenting the auspicious sign, presenting completion, requesting the date, fetching the bride, sharing the wedding feast, temple presentation, meeting the parents-in-law, the mother-in-law's ceremonial wine to the bride, hand-washing and serving food, entertaining the bride, and escorting the bride—all followed weddings for imperial princes and those below them.
translations.idiomatic: Initial gift presentation, asking the name, presenting the auspicious sign, presenting completion, requesting the date, fetching the bride, sharing the wedding feast, temple presentation, meeting the parents-in-law, the mother-in-law's ceremonial wine to the bride, hand-washing and serving food, entertaining the bride, and escorting the bride—all followed weddings for imperial princes and those below them.

sentences.zh: 四品以下不用盥饋、饗婦禮。

translations.literal: Officials of the fourth rank and below did not use the hand-washing-and-serving or entertaining-the-bride rites.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of the fourth rank and below did not use the hand-washing-and-serving or entertaining-the-bride rites.

sentences.zh: 士庶人婚禮。

translations.literal: Wedding rites for scholars and commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Wedding rites for scholars and commoners.

sentences.zh: 並問名於納采，並請期於納成。

translations.literal: Asking the name was combined with initial gift presentation; requesting the date was combined with presenting completion.
translations.idiomatic: Asking the name was combined with initial gift presentation; requesting the date was combined with presenting completion.

sentences.zh: 其無雁奠者，三舍生聽用羊，庶人聽以雉及雞鶩代。

translations.literal: Where there was no wild-goose offering, students of the Three Halls were permitted to use a sheep; commoners were permitted to substitute pheasant and domestic fowl.
translations.idiomatic: Where there was no wild-goose offering, students of the Three Halls were permitted to use a sheep; commoners were permitted to substitute pheasant and domestic fowl.

sentences.zh: 其辭稱“吾子”。

translations.literal: In the formulae they said "my son."
translations.idiomatic: In the formulae they said "my son."

sentences.zh: 親迎。

translations.literal: Fetching the bride in person.
translations.idiomatic: Fetching the bride in person.

sentences.zh: 質明，掌事者設禰位廳事東間，南向。

translations.literal: At first light, the officer in charge set the seat of the immediate forebear in the eastern side room of the reception hall, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: At first light, the officer in charge set the seat of the immediate forebear in the eastern side room of the reception hall, facing south.

sentences.zh: 婿之父服其服，北面再拜，祝曰：“某子某，年若干，禮宜有室，聘某氏第幾女，以某日親迎，敢告。

translations.literal: The groom's father dressed in his proper attire, bowed twice facing north, and prayed: "So-and-so's son So-and-so, aged such-and-such, ought by rite to take a wife; betrothed to such-and-such daughter of the Such-and-such clan, on such-and-such a day he fetches the bride in person—I dare announce it.
translations.idiomatic: The groom's father dressed in his proper attire, bowed twice facing north, and prayed: "So-and-so's son So-and-so, aged such-and-such, ought by rite to take a wife; betrothed to such-and-such daughter of the Such-and-such clan, on such-and-such a day he fetches the bride in person—I dare announce it.

sentences.zh: ”子將行，父 坐廳事，南向，子服其服，

translations.literal: " When the son was about to depart, the father sat in the reception hall facing south; the son dressed in his proper attire,
translations.idiomatic: " When the son was about to depart, the father sat in the reception hall facing south; the son dressed in his proper attire,

sentences.zh: 〈（三舍生及品官子孫假九品服，餘並皂衫衣、折上巾。）〉

translations.literal: (Students of the Three Halls and descendants of ranked officials wore the dress of the ninth rank by temporary authorization; all others wore black robes and folded-up caps.)
translations.idiomatic: (Students of the Three Halls and descendants of ranked officials wore the dress of the ninth rank by temporary authorization; all others wore black robes and folded-up caps.)

sentences.zh: 立父位西，少南，東向。

translations.literal: stood west of the father's seat, slightly to the south, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: Stood west of the father's seat, slightly to the south, facing east.

sentences.zh: 讚者注酒於盞授子，子再拜，跪受，讚者又以饌設位 前，子舉酒興，即坐飲食訖，降，再拜，進立父位前，命之曰：“厘爾內治，往求爾匹。

translations.literal: The announcer poured wine into a cup and handed it to the son; the son bowed twice, knelt to receive it; the announcer also set food before the seat; the son raised his cup in pledge, then sat, ate and drank to completion, descended, bowed twice, advanced to stand before the father's seat; the father charged him, saying: "Put your inner household in order; go seek your match.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer poured wine into a cup and handed it to the son; the son bowed twice, knelt to receive it; the announcer also set food before the seat; the son raised his cup in pledge, then sat, ate and drank to completion, descended, bowed twice, advanced to stand before the father's seat; the father charged him, saying: "Put your inner household in order; go seek your match.

sentences.zh: ”子再拜，曰：“敢不奉命。

translations.literal: " The son bowed twice and said: "How could I dare not accept the command?
translations.idiomatic: " The son bowed twice and said: "How could I dare not accept the command?

sentences.zh: ”又再拜，降出。

translations.literal: " He bowed twice again and descended to depart.
translations.idiomatic: " He bowed twice again and descended to depart.

sentences.zh: 初婚，掌事者 設酒饌室中，置二盞於槃，婿服其服如前服，至女家，讚者引就次，掌事者設禰位，主人受禮，如請期之儀。

translations.literal: For a first marriage, the officer in charge set wine and food in the room and placed two cups on a tray; the groom dressed as before, went to the bride's home; the announcer led him to the pavilion; the officer in charge set the seat of the immediate forebear; the host received the rite following the procedure for requesting the date.
translations.idiomatic: For a first marriage, the officer in charge set wine and food in the room and placed two cups on a tray; the groom dressed as before, went to the bride's home; the announcer led him to the pavilion; the officer in charge set the seat of the immediate forebear; the host received the rite following the procedure for requesting the date.

sentences.zh: 〈（主人謂女父。）〉

translations.literal: (The host refers to the bride's father.)
translations.idiomatic: (The host refers to the bride's father.)

sentences.zh: 女盛服立房中，父升階立房外之東， 西向。

translations.literal: The bride in full dress stood in the inner room; the father ascended the steps and stood east outside the room, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The bride in full dress stood in the inner room; the father ascended the steps and stood east outside the room, facing west.

sentences.zh: 〈（非南向者，各隨其所向。

translations.literal: (Where rooms did not face south, each followed its own orientation.
translations.idiomatic: (Where rooms did not face south, each followed its own orientation.

sentences.zh: 父立於門外之左，餘放此。）〉

translations.literal: The father stood to the left outside the door; the rest followed this pattern.)
translations.idiomatic: The father stood to the left outside the door; the rest followed this pattern.)

sentences.zh: 讚者注酒於盞授女，女再拜受盞；

translations.literal: The announcer poured wine into a cup and handed it to the bride; the bride bowed twice and received the cup;
translations.idiomatic: The announcer poured wine into a cup and handed it to the bride; the bride bowed twice and received the cup;

sentences.zh: 讚者又以饌設於位前，女即坐飲食訖，降，再拜。

translations.literal: the announcer also set food before the seat; the bride then sat, ate and drank to completion, descended, and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: the announcer also set food before the seat; the bride then sat, ate and drank to completion, descended, and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 父降立東階下， 賓出次，

translations.literal: The father descended and stood below the eastern steps; the guest came out of the pavilion,
translations.idiomatic: The father descended and stood below the eastern steps; the guest came out of the pavilion,

translations.literal: (The guest refers to the groom.)
translations.idiomatic: (The guest refers to the groom.)

sentences.zh: 主人迎於門，揖賓入，賓報揖，從入。

translations.literal: The host received him at the gate, bowed with joined hands to invite the guest in; the guest returned the bow and followed him in.
translations.idiomatic: The host received him at the gate, bowed with joined hands to invite the guest in; the guest returned the bow and followed him in.

sentences.zh: 主人升東階，西面；

translations.literal: The host ascended the eastern steps, facing west;
translations.idiomatic: The host ascended the eastern steps, facing west;

sentences.zh: 賓升西階，進當房戶前，北面。

translations.literal: the guest ascended the western steps and advanced to stand before the room door, facing north.
translations.idiomatic: the guest ascended the western steps and advanced to stand before the room door, facing north.

sentences.zh: 掌事者陳雁於階，賓曰：“某受命於父，以茲嘉 禮，躬聽成命。

translations.literal: The officer in charge displayed the wild geese on the steps; the guest said: "So-and-so has received a command from his father and, by this auspicious rite, comes in person to await the completion of the charge.
translations.idiomatic: The officer in charge displayed the wild geese on the steps; the guest said: "So-and-so has received a command from his father and, by this auspicious rite, comes in person to await the completion of the charge.

sentences.zh: ”主人曰：“某固願從命。

translations.literal: " The host said: "So-and-so has long wished to comply with the command.
translations.idiomatic: " The host said: "So-and-so has long wished to comply with the command.

sentences.zh: ”賓再拜，降出，主人不降送。

translations.literal: " The guest bowed twice, descended and departed; the host did not descend to see him off.
translations.idiomatic: " The guest bowed twice, descended and departed; the host did not descend to see him off.

sentences.zh: 初，女出，父戒之曰：“往之汝家，無忘肅恭！

translations.literal: At first, when the bride came out, the father admonished her, saying: "Go to your husband's home and do not forget reverent respect!
translations.idiomatic: At first, when the bride came out, the father admonished her, saying: "Go to your husband's home and do not forget reverent respect!

sentences.zh: ”母戒之曰：“夙夜以思，無有違命！

translations.literal: " The mother admonished her, saying: "Reflect upon this morning and evening, and do not disobey any command!
translations.idiomatic: " The mother admonished her, saying: "Reflect upon this morning and evening, and do not disobey any command!

sentences.zh: ” 諸母申之曰：“無違爾父母之訓！

translations.literal: " All the mothers reiterated: "Do not disobey the instructions of your parents!
translations.idiomatic: " The other mothers added their counsel: "Never go against what your parents have taught you!

sentences.zh: ”女出，婿先還，俟於門外。

translations.literal: " The bride came out; the groom returned first and waited outside the gate.
translations.idiomatic: " The bride departed; the groom went ahead to his home and waited for her at the gate.

sentences.zh: 婦至，讚者引就北面立，婿南面，揖以入，至於室。

translations.literal: When the bride arrived, the announcer led her to stand facing north; the groom faced south, bowed with joined hands to invite her in, and they entered the inner room.
translations.idiomatic: When the bride arrived, the announcer guided her to her place facing north; the groom, facing south, bowed to receive her, and together they entered the bridal chamber.

sentences.zh: 掌事者設對位室中，婿婦皆即坐，讚者注酒於盞 授婿及婦，婿及婦受盞飲訖。

translations.literal: The officer in charge set facing seats in the room; groom and bride both took their seats; the announcer poured wine into cups and handed them to groom and bride; groom and bride received the cups and drank to completion.
translations.idiomatic: The officer in charge arranged facing seats in the room, and groom and bride both sat down; the announcer filled cups with wine and presented them to each; groom and bride accepted the cups and drank them dry.

sentences.zh: 遂設饌，再飲、三飲，並如上儀。

translations.literal: Then food was set out; second and third drinking followed, all as in the procedure above.
translations.idiomatic: Food was then served, and the second and third rounds of wine followed the same procedure as before.

sentences.zh: 婿及婦皆興，再拜，讚者徹酒饌。

translations.literal: Groom and bride both rose, bowed twice, and the announcer removed the wine and food.
translations.idiomatic: Groom and bride both stood, bowed twice, and the announcer cleared away the wine and food.

sentences.zh: 見祖禰、見舅姑、醴婦、饗送者，如儀。

translations.literal: Presentation to forebears, meeting the parents-in-law, ceremonial wine to the bride, and entertaining the escorts all followed the prescribed procedure.
translations.idiomatic: The rites of presenting themselves to forebears, meeting the parents-in-law, the mother-in-law's ceremonial wine to the bride, and entertaining the escorts were all performed according to regulation.
